final_holdout.purpose: read once, at the end, for the final number
final_holdout.status: NOT YET READ by any published number on this site; the corpus exists and is counted, but no published figure is computed on it

note_on_holdout: The holdout corpus is counted here so its size is on the record, but no published number on this site is computed from it. That is the whole point of a holdout.
rule: Seasons are assigned to exactly one split. The final holdout is never read while a rule, a threshold, a parameter or a feature is being chosen. A rule that has been tuned against the holdout stops being a holdout, and the repository records the date that happened rather than pretending otherwise.

train.purpose: fit scoring levels, fit parameters, choose rules

validation.purpose: choose among already-fitted rules; no refitting
